snippet.title: Frostpunk 2 | Free Major Content Update
snippet.description:
Check out the full changelog here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1601580/view/498320947205373969?l=english

The Free Major Content Update for #Frostpunk 2 is now live, implementing ⬇️⬇️⬇️

❄️ Heat management - New gameplay feature where the temperature is now managed at the district level, adding more depth and strategy to city management. 
❄️ Tales from the frostland - New challenges that expand the Utopia Builder experience.
❄️ The Pit – A new Utopia Builder map featuring rugged terrain and a unique crater setting, offering fresh city-building challenges.
❄️ Mod support - Frostkit 1.0 modding tool is now available for everyone!
❄️ Serenity Mode - Perfect for newcomers or players seeking a more reflective pace in the development of their cities and societies (hey, we can’t blame you, it’s really cold out there!). 
❄️ UI upgrades, improvements & much more!
